nodes.label: Unnamed NPCs (Hollow Knight)
nodes.fragment: Nameless enough to be everyone at once — the ones who gossip by the hot spring, the ones who never got closer than the horizon.

nodes.label: Bardoon
nodes.fragment: Climbed as high as legs would carry him, just to keep his mind his own a little longer.

nodes.label: Blue Child Joni
nodes.fragment: Gave away a blessing so long ago that even her own ghost has forgotten the gesture.

nodes.label: Bretta
nodes.fragment: Waited in the dark for someone to notice her, and fell for the first one who finally did.

nodes.label: Brumm
nodes.fragment: Follows the Ritual out of duty, and quietly plots to be the reason it finally stops.

nodes.label: Charm Lover Salubra
nodes.fragment: Sells notches for a kingdom she still believes is thriving just outside her door.

nodes.label: Cloth
nodes.fragment: Talks bravely, hides often, and hopes the ending, when it comes, is worth all the boasting.

nodes.label: Confessor Jiji
nodes.fragment: Slept behind a door no one dared open, and now fears what waking a second time might cost.

nodes.label: Cornifer
nodes.fragment: Left his own nest before he'd learned to fly, and has been mapping his way home ever since.

nodes.label: Divine
nodes.fragment: Hungers for what's fragile, and hands back only what's learned to survive her.

nodes.label: Dreamers
nodes.fragment: Chose to sleep forever so something far worse never has to wake.

nodes.label: Dung Defender
nodes.fragment: Traded glory for a stench no one else would tolerate, and still calls the trade fair.

nodes.label: Elderbug
nodes.fragment: Watched everyone he knew chase a dream down the well, and decided dreams weren't worth chasing after that.

nodes.label: Eternal Emilitia
nodes.fragment: Was cast out long before the rot came for everyone who kept her — outliving them still makes her laugh.

nodes.label: Fluke Hermit
nodes.fragment: Calls the junk pit's leavings treasure, and wonders quietly if the throne beneath it is hers now.

nodes.label: Godseeker
nodes.fragment: Carries an entire tribe inside one skull, all of them still looking for something worth worshipping.

nodes.label: Grey Mourner
nodes.fragment: Carries flowers from a homeland no one here remembers, to a grave love was never allowed to reach.

nodes.label: Grubfather
nodes.fragment: Counts an empty room where his children used to be, and waits for the jars to open.

nodes.label: Herrah the Beast
nodes.fragment: Ruled alone after love died, and slept forever rather than bow to a king she never accepted.

nodes.label: Hive Queen Vespa
nodes.fragment: Grew too vast to ever leave her own hall, and taught someone smaller how to be fast instead.

nodes.label: Hornet (Hollow Knight)
nodes.fragment: Tests every stranger twice before deciding they've earned the right to keep walking these halls.

nodes.label: The Hunter
nodes.fragment: Was taught to hunt by hunting his own siblings, and never really stopped.

nodes.label: Iselda
nodes.fragment: Traded a blade for a quiet shop, and spends her days worrying about the one who still carries one.

nodes.label: Last Stag
nodes.fragment: Forgets half the roads he used to know by heart, but still comes running the moment a bell rings.

nodes.label: Leg Eater
nodes.fragment: Can't see a single coin but always finds one, and dreams of a crown he'll never quite afford.

nodes.label: Little Fool
nodes.fragment: Hangs upside down at the gate, selling other people's glory while dreaming of earning some of his own.

nodes.label: Lurien the Watcher
nodes.fragment: Watched an entire city through a single long lens, and chose to close his eyes rather than see it fall.

nodes.label: Marissa
nodes.fragment: Still sings to a house that emptied out long ago, note for note, as if someone might still be listening.

nodes.label: Mask Maker (Hollow Knight)
nodes.fragment: Hands out faces to the faceless, and no longer bothers asking which kind she's wearing herself.

nodes.label: Midwife
nodes.fragment: Still offers her old services to a nursery gone quiet, though hunger tends to answer first these days.

nodes.label: Millibelle the Banker
nodes.fragment: Calls herself a bank and means it, right up until the moment it's more profitable not to.

nodes.label: Mister Mushroom (Hollow Knight)
nodes.fragment: Wanders the kingdom babbling half a warning to anyone who'll follow the sound of his voice.

nodes.label: Monomon the Teacher
nodes.fragment: Filled her archive with half-sentences about kings and voids, hoping someone later would know how to finish them.

nodes.label: Moss Prophet
nodes.fragment: Preaches that the light will remake the kingdom, unaware the glow already eating their flock is the proof.

nodes.label: Myla
nodes.fragment: Hears the crystals singing to her, and mistakes it for music. For now.

nodes.label: Nailmaster Mato
nodes.fragment: Was never the most gifted student, only the one who cared enough to keep teaching anyway.

nodes.label: Nailmaster Oro
nodes.fragment: Carries a debt to his own brother he still hasn't found the nerve to repay.

nodes.label: Nailmaster Sheo
nodes.fragment: Mastered the blade completely, then set it down the moment mastery stopped meaning anything.

nodes.label: Nailsmith
nodes.fragment: Barely noticed his kingdom collapse, too absorbed chasing the one perfect blade he still hasn't made.

nodes.label: Nymm
nodes.fragment: Forgot the name and reason he came, and settled for playing a small, sad song for anyone left to hear.

nodes.label: The Pale King
nodes.fragment: Wore a crown grown from a shed skin, and asked an entire kingdom to forget what he used to be.

nodes.label: Quirrel
nodes.fragment: Carries his teacher's mask on his own head, and half her purpose in it, though he can't remember why.

nodes.label: Relic Seeker Lemm
nodes.fragment: Moved into a tower emptied by death, and started filling it back up with other people's history.

nodes.label: Revek
nodes.fragment: Stands watch over graves that no longer need guarding, and punishes anyone who disagrees.

nodes.label: Seer
nodes.fragment: Tends graves for a tribe that forgot its own god, and hopes a stranger might remember better.

nodes.label: Sly
nodes.fragment: Traded mastery of the blade for the simpler comfort of counting coins, though he never quite let go of it.

nodes.label: Snail Shaman
nodes.fragment: Bound to one small mound while his kin wander free somewhere he'll never learn the fate of.

nodes.label: Spirits
nodes.fragment: Lingers exactly where it fell, still convinced, somehow, that it's the one still living.

nodes.label: Steel Soul Jinn
nodes.fragment: Sleeps for masters she won't name, and insists she's too young to explain the rest.

nodes.label: Thistlewind
nodes.fragment: Stopped traveling only because dying does that, and still wonders what became of the one who kept going.

nodes.label: Tiso
nodes.fragment: Talked louder than he fought, and the arena remembers him only as one more body by the acid.

nodes.label: The Traitors' Child
nodes.fragment: Loved someone her own people refused to accept, and got a grave instead of a wedding.

nodes.label: Troupe Master Grimm
nodes.fragment: Leads a circus that only ever performs one ritual, over and over, until something new is born to replace him.

nodes.label: Tuk
nodes.fragment: Waits in the sewage for an apology that hasn't come yet, and eats whatever the water provides in the meantime.

nodes.label: Unnamed Moth
nodes.fragment: Stands outside a shrine of other people's faith, unconvinced, and says so to anyone who'll listen.

nodes.label: White Lady
nodes.fragment: Built a garden to forget a kingdom, and became a mother to a child that wasn't quite hers to keep.

nodes.label: Willoh
nodes.fragment: Rations a strange fungus and eyes every visitor the same way — as company, or as dinner, depending on the day.

nodes.label: Zote the Mighty
nodes.fragment: Named his blade for a power it was never built to have, and never once noticed the difference.

nodes.label: Absolute Radiance
nodes.fragment: What the light becomes once nothing is left to dim it.

nodes.label: Broken Vessel
nodes.fragment: Escaped the same dark the Knight did, and simply had worse luck once it got out.

nodes.label: Brooding Mawlek
nodes.fragment: Calls out for kin that stopped answering long before the sickness gave it a reason to scream.

nodes.label: Brothers Oro & Mato
nodes.fragment: Fight side by side the way they trained — in step, even now, even here.

nodes.label: The Collector
nodes.fragment: Smiles while it jars anything that moves, calling the cage a kindness and the kindness love.

nodes.label: Crystal Guardian
nodes.fragment: Still digs, still shrieks in a voice that isn't quite his, encased in the very stone he used to mine.

nodes.label: Elder Hu
nodes.fragment: Came to cure a sickness he mistook for everyone but himself, and paid for the mistake in full.

nodes.label: Enraged Guardian
nodes.fragment: Whatever patience the first form had left, this one burned through completely.

nodes.label: Failed Champion
nodes.fragment: Dreams the same failure over and over, faster each time, as if speed alone could rewrite the ending.

nodes.label: False Knight
nodes.fragment: Borrowed a dead knight's armor to protect a family that never knew how close it came to losing him.

nodes.label: Flukemarm
nodes.fragment: Can't leave the cave she fills with her own children — sick or not, breeding is the only freedom left her.

nodes.label: Galien
nodes.fragment: Went looking for a fight worthy of a king's attention, and found only the one that finally ended him.

nodes.label: God Tamer
nodes.fragment: Small enough to be underestimated, so she brought something large enough that no one makes that mistake twice.

nodes.label: Gorb
nodes.fragment: Believed enlightenment was something you could recruit others into, and never once doubted the size of his own mind.

nodes.label: Great Nailsage Sly
nodes.fragment: Fights now the way he once only taught — every strike remembered perfectly, none of them softened by age.

nodes.label: Grey Prince Zote
nodes.fragment: Grew powerful only inside someone else's daydream, which makes him, in a strange way, the strongest version there ever was.

nodes.label: Gruz Mother
nodes.fragment: Sleeps off the exhaustion of motherhood in the middle of the road, and wakes up furious at whoever interrupts the rest.

nodes.label: Hive Knight
nodes.fragment: Guards a queen long dead, still convinced devotion alone might be enough to wake her.

nodes.label: The Hollow Knight
nodes.fragment: Was built to be empty enough to hold a god's fury, and came just short of being empty enough.

nodes.label: Hornet Protector
nodes.fragment: Held back her full strength the first time, certain the intruder wouldn't need more than a warning.

nodes.label: Hornet Sentinel
nodes.fragment: Comes back with everything she held in reserve the first time, because a warning clearly wasn't enough.

nodes.label: Lost Kin
nodes.fragment: The same tragedy, replayed faster, as if urgency could undo how it already ended.

nodes.label: Mantis Lords
nodes.fragment: Three sisters guarding one truce, still honoring terms the rest of the kingdom stopped keeping long ago.

nodes.label: Markoth
nodes.fragment: Meditated alone so long in that cave he stopped noticing his own body had already died beside him.

nodes.label: Marmu
nodes.fragment: Waited by the garden gate for a lesson in flying the years never quite delivered.

nodes.label: Massive Moss Charger
nodes.fragment: Looks like a single sleeping giant, and turns out, once struck, to have never been alone at all.

nodes.label: Nightmare King Grimm
nodes.fragment: The circus master's own nightmare of himself, and somehow still hungrier than the original.

nodes.label: No Eyes
nodes.fragment: Tore her own sight away rather than let the light finish the job, and called the dark a mercy.

nodes.label: Nosk
nodes.fragment: Wears whichever face you loved most, right up until it's close enough to matter.

nodes.label: Oblobbles
nodes.fragment: Trained in pairs to fight as one, and turn twice as vicious the moment they're down to one.

nodes.label: Paintmaster Sheo
nodes.fragment: Paints the arena in the same strokes he once used for art, before deciding a blade wasn't worth the mess.

nodes.label: Pure Vessel
nodes.fragment: What the sealed sibling might have become, if nothing had ever gotten in.

nodes.label: The Radiance
nodes.fragment: Was worshipped, then quietly replaced, and never once accepted being forgotten as the ending.

nodes.label: Sisters of Battle
nodes.fragment: Three fights that used to be separate, now happening all at once, because patience stopped being an option.

nodes.label: Soul Master
nodes.fragment: Believed he'd found the cure inside the very sickness that was already rewriting his own mind.

nodes.label: Soul Tyrant
nodes.fragment: The same conviction, wound tighter, moving faster toward the same mistaken cure.

nodes.label: Soul Warrior
nodes.fragment: Traded memory for power, and can no longer quite recall which came first.

nodes.label: Traitor Lord
nodes.fragment: Chose strength over his own tribe, and a stolen garden over a daughter he'd already lost to love.

nodes.label: Uumuu
nodes.fragment: Guards a sleeping teacher behind a wall of itself, soft until struck, and dangerous only then.

nodes.label: Vengefly King
nodes.fragment: Rules a small patch of ceiling fiercely enough to make a meal of anyone who wanders under it.

nodes.label: Watcher Knight
nodes.fragment: Died standing guard, and got reanimated by the very sickness it once would have fought off.

nodes.label: White Defender
nodes.fragment: Remembers a glory the waking self gave up on, and fights like nothing was ever traded away.

nodes.label: Winged Nosk
nodes.fragment: Wears a different borrowed face this time, and finds new ways to fall from higher up.

nodes.label: Xero
nodes.fragment: Turned on his king out of a conviction he still won't call wrong, buried as a warning no one reads the same way twice.

nodes.label: The Abyss (Hollow Knight)
nodes.fragment: A pit full of the shells of children no one came back for, with Void pooling patiently at the bottom.

nodes.label: Ancient Basin
nodes.fragment: Bones and rock and a fountain that still takes offerings for a king who stopped listening long ago.

nodes.label: City of Tears
nodes.fragment: Rain falls the same on every tower, rich or ruined, as if the sky never learned to tell them apart.

nodes.label: Colosseum of Fools
nodes.fragment: Built inside the carcass of something even older than the kingdom, and still finds new bodies to fill the arena.

nodes.label: Crystal Peak
nodes.fragment: The crystal grows into the miners as readily as they mine it, until it's hard to say which one is being harvested.

nodes.label: Deepnest
nodes.fragment: No two maps agree on its shape, because nothing that lives here wants to be found the same way twice.

nodes.label: Dirtmouth
nodes.fragment: A town that used to be a gateway, now just a doorstep for a kingdom nobody living remembers opening.

nodes.label: Fog Canyon
nodes.fragment: Mist thick enough to hide the acid until you're already standing in it.

nodes.label: Forgotten Crossroads
nodes.fragment: These roads still remember where they used to lead, long after the travelers wore down to bone.

nodes.label: Fungal Wastes
nodes.fragment: Every mushroom here is someone's territory, and every clearing is a border somebody's willing to defend.

nodes.label: Godhome
nodes.fragment: Built for losing, over and over, to those who call dying a kind of practice.

nodes.label: Greenpath
nodes.fragment: Green enough to hide in, and the things that live here learned that lesson generations before anyone came looking.

nodes.label: The Hive
nodes.fragment: Built entirely from its own labor, comb by comb, by bees still working for a queen who can no longer leave.

nodes.label: Howling Cliffs
nodes.fragment: Marks the edge of a kingdom that used to matter, littered with the husks of things that tried to leave it.

nodes.label: Kingdom's Edge
nodes.fragment: Ash falls here the way rain falls elsewhere — constant, indifferent, burying whoever the arena throws down first.

nodes.label: Queen's Gardens
nodes.fragment: A garden gone feral enough that even its trespassers have started to feel like they belong.

nodes.label: Resting Grounds
nodes.fragment: A graveyard built by a tribe that then joined the very dead they came here to remember.

nodes.label: Royal Waterways
nodes.fragment: Everything the city upstream doesn't want ends up flowing down here eventually, including, in time, the city itself.

nodes.label: White Palace
nodes.fragment: A palace preserved only in dream, kept spotless by blades that never once stopped moving to let the dust settle.

nodes.label: Aged Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Complains about the climb at every rest stop, and keeps climbing anyway, the way pilgrims always seem to.

nodes.label: Alchemist Zylotol
nodes.fragment: Was sent to study a miracle in dirt that was never supposed to produce one, and hasn't given up hope yet.

nodes.label: Ballow
nodes.fragment: Keeps his head down and his senses whole among coworkers who kept neither, and calls that his whole achievement.

nodes.label: Beastlings
nodes.fragment: Sing along with their mother the moment they're called, too young yet to know any other kind of answer.

nodes.label: Bell Beast
nodes.fragment: Was chained by thread until something stronger cut her loose, and now carries strangers the way she once carried her own captivity.

nodes.label: Bell Hermit
nodes.fragment: Calls every rescue a new kind of leash, and has buried enough family to have earned the right to say so.

nodes.label: Broodling
nodes.fragment: Is already being fed toward becoming the very cycle it was just born out of.

nodes.label: Caretaker
nodes.fragment: Rings the same bell every day while quietly plotting the one act that could silence the whole chorus.

nodes.label: Chapel Maid
nodes.fragment: Keeps a chapel that the faithful abandoned, and still calls it tending rather than mourning.

nodes.label: Cogwork Statues
nodes.fragment: Ask for a song before they'll open the last door, as if music alone could prove anyone worth the climb.

nodes.label: Conductor Ballador
nodes.fragment: Kept alive by a single thread of Silk, and spends what's left of himself wondering if the fall was his fault.

nodes.label: Couriers Tipp & Pill
nodes.fragment: Still calls his brother 'young' long after neither of them has much right to the word anymore.

nodes.label: Creige
nodes.fragment: Pours the same drink for every exhausted pilgrim, and remembers a road that used to be easier than this one.

nodes.label: Crull and Benjin
nodes.fragment: Argue about whether the food was ever really better, and keep raising roaches either way.

nodes.label: Dejected Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Wonders whether the new ruin is a punishment or a test, unable to imagine a third, worse option: neither.

nodes.label: Eva
nodes.fragment: Was spun to prove a curse could be broken, and grew distant from her own mothers once she started to wonder whether it was.

nodes.label: Exhausted Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Believes every ache will vanish the moment the Citadel comes into view, and hasn't been proven wrong yet.

nodes.label: Fayforn
nodes.fragment: Answers those who climb high enough to ask her something, though not always with the answer they were hoping for.

nodes.label: Fearful Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Meditates just far enough from the others to feel brave, and just close enough to still call for help.

nodes.label: Flea
nodes.fragment: Small enough to be forgotten in a cage, loud enough not to stay that way once someone finally listens.

nodes.label: Flea Caravan
nodes.fragment: Wanders looking for every flea that got left behind, and somehow keeps finding a few more.

nodes.label: Fleamaster Mooshka
nodes.fragment: Leads a caravan of the smallest, most easily lost creatures in the kingdom, and hasn't given up on finding them all somewhere safe.

nodes.label: Flick the Fixer
nodes.fragment: Knows it's shameful for a pilgrim to stop moving, and stayed anyway because someone had to fix what kept breaking.

nodes.label: Forge Daughter
nodes.fragment: Keeps her mind clear in a dock full of haunted ones, and spends that clarity forging tools for someone else's journey.

nodes.label: Frey
nodes.fragment: Waited out the town's haunting behind a locked door, living off whatever was already on the shelves.

nodes.label: Garmond and Zaza
nodes.fragment: Are the only two left of a village the Haunting erased, and carry that math with them into every fight.

nodes.label: Gilly
nodes.fragment: Hid herself as a bush to study why these fields still grow while everything around them turns to dust.

nodes.label: Great Gourmand
nodes.fragment: Eats every meal in total silence, and calls the silence afterward reflection rather than what it might actually be.

nodes.label: Green Prince
nodes.fragment: Watched his partner become a statue to save a kingdom that fell anyway, and is now the last one left who remembers why.

nodes.label: Greyroot
nodes.fragment: Used to receive offerings from travelers who never came back, and doesn't get visitors anymore for exactly that reason.

nodes.label: Grindle
nodes.fragment: Calls it light thievery, the same way everyone in a cell calls their own crime the lightest one there is.

nodes.label: Grishkin
nodes.fragment: Sells a drink brewed for creatures whose future is still being decided, and no longer bothers charging for it.

nodes.label: Horned Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Calls a weapon a sin even on a road this dangerous, and leaves before anyone can prove him wrong.

nodes.label: Humble Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Heard a child laughing somewhere in halls that shouldn't hold any children left, and still isn't sure they believe it.

nodes.label: Huntress
nodes.fragment: Gathers a feast large enough that her children might, for once, choose it over her — and hates how much relief that hope brings.

nodes.label: Jubilana
nodes.fragment: Spent a whole life inside golden halls now past their prime, and still can't call them anything but holy.

nodes.label: Kratt
nodes.fragment: Was found tangled in the same thread that catches everyone else, and offered a reward the moment he got loose.

nodes.label: Lace
nodes.fragment: Spun to love her mother awake, and loyal enough never to ask what she was made to replace.

nodes.label: Loam
nodes.fragment: Runs in place to keep a city lit he's never once been allowed to enter, and calls the running hope.

nodes.label: Loddie
nodes.fragment: Runs a game of chance to bring joy back to a kingdom running low on it, and doesn't mention what's left of his own tribe.

nodes.label: Loyal Mergwin
nodes.fragment: Still cooks for a master he calls the finest who ever lived, unaware the kitchen he serves is already ruins.

nodes.label: Lumble the Lucky
nodes.fragment: Bets everything he's carrying on a game of chance, alone on a road that's already one long gamble.

nodes.label: Mask Maker (Silksong)
nodes.fragment: Hums the same lines about needing a face to anyone who'll listen, though no one's ever sure if he's convincing them or himself.

nodes.label: Mister Mushroom (Silksong)
nodes.fragment: Buries himself across the whole kingdom in pieces, and only answers to a song, never to a name.

nodes.label: Mort
nodes.fragment: Charges a toll at a door that locks itself the moment you leave, and never once questions why.

nodes.label: Moss Druid
nodes.fragment: Might be the last of an entire kind, and spends what's left of that loneliness brewing visions no one else is around to share.

nodes.label: Mottled Skarr
nodes.fragment: Wears a mark his own kin call a curse, and stays loyal to a tribe that's dwindling anyway.

nodes.label: Nuu
nodes.fragment: Has already written down more of the world's dying things than anyone else bothered to notice.

nodes.label: Old Penitent
nodes.fragment: Came here to atone in silence, and still flinches with longing every time music slips in past the walls.

nodes.label: Pavo
nodes.fragment: Welcomed every stranger through the gate, right up until the thread caught him too, mid-greeting.

nodes.label: Pebb
nodes.fragment: Sells off everything she owns for a currency she's betting will matter more than the owning ever did.

nodes.label: Pilby
nodes.fragment: Admits the camp is falling apart, and insists the falling apart is exactly what the faith is for.

nodes.label: Pilgrim Preacher
nodes.fragment: Warns of the haunted things further in, then quietly becomes one more absence himself, sooner or later.

nodes.label: Pinmaster Plinney
nodes.fragment: Sharpens strangers' weapons all day, and keeps one grave in Shellwood he never mentions unless asked twice.

nodes.label: Pious Isamor
nodes.fragment: Used to greet every new arrival before the Citadel learned to prefer gold to welcome, and got left in the dark for it.

nodes.label: Pondcatcher Reed
nodes.fragment: Is the last of their trade still standing, and keeps hunting for a town that mostly can't hunt for itself anymore.

nodes.label: Quiet Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Asks for silence on a road full of noise, and finds even the quietest visitor somehow too loud.

nodes.label: Relic Seeker Scrounge
nodes.fragment: Trusts old objects to tell the truth more than any of the neighbors she's stopped bothering to talk to.

nodes.label: Runt
nodes.fragment: Was too small to join the feast that ate their own mother, and calls that smallness the reason they're still here.

nodes.label: Scared Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Is afraid of nearly everything left in the Citadel, and grateful, in spite of that, for the one corner that still feels safe.

nodes.label: Seamstress
nodes.fragment: Was one of the last of a warrior order, and chose, eventually, to become someone that order wouldn't recognize.

nodes.label: Shakra
nodes.fragment: Left a home she can never return to, in search of a master she still hasn't found, and sells maps to everyone else's destinations instead.

nodes.label: Sherma
nodes.fragment: Sings to inanimate objects with the same warmth he gives to strangers, and hasn't yet learned the road punishes that kind of trust.

nodes.label: Shrine Guardian Seth
nodes.fragment: Counts every stranger he's killed defending a shrine, and grieves each one without ever once considering not fighting.

nodes.label: Skarrsinger Karmelita
nodes.fragment: Once sang an entire tribe into resisting a god, and is fought now only as a memory of the voice that used to work.

nodes.label: Skynx
nodes.fragment: Waits in the dark for someone willing to trade, and only steps into the light once she's sure they've noticed her first.

nodes.label: Snail Shamans (Silksong)
nodes.fragment: Built a trap clever enough to catch a god, and never once considered what catching her might let loose instead.

nodes.label: Solemn Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Sings a farewell for a stranger whose name might not even survive the singing of it.

nodes.label: Sprintmaster Swift
nodes.fragment: Built a racetrack around the bones of something enormous, and waits there for someone fast enough to be worth racing.

nodes.label: Steel Seer Zi
nodes.fragment: Answers to masters she's never seen, and hunts down anyone who decides that's not worth doing anymore.

nodes.label: Styx
nodes.fragment: Built an entire pantry hoping to attract a master strong enough to finally own him.

nodes.label: Sula
nodes.fragment: Got tired of watching the world die quietly, and called something out of the Void rather than keep serving the ones killing it.

nodes.label: Tall Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Begs a locked gate to open for the mighty ones on the other side, and knows exactly which bells might make them listen.

nodes.label: Tormented Trobbio
nodes.fragment: Hides beneath his own stage, consumed by a sadness too large for the kingdom collapsing around him to fully explain.

nodes.label: Twelfth Architect
nodes.fragment: Was built only to follow orders, and is running out of time just as it's finally starting to have opinions of its own.

nodes.label: Unnamed Skarr
nodes.fragment: Wears the same mark that gets others exiled, and hides underground before anyone can decide what to do about it.

nodes.label: Varga
nodes.fragment: Calls every temporary stop cozy, and is reluctant, every single time, to admit the caravan has to move on.

nodes.label: Vaultkeeper Cardinius
nodes.fragment: Is the only one of his order who still remembers what all that hoarded history was even for.

nodes.label: Vog
nodes.fragment: Tracked down every last lost flea in the kingdom alone, and only then let herself join the company of others.

nodes.label: Weary Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Answers a friend's song with nothing but moans now, worn past the point where encouragement still helps.

nodes.label: Worried Pilgrim
nodes.fragment: Calls the stranger who saved her a golden knight, and carries the admiration like it might be the last good thing she keeps.

nodes.label: Yarnaby
nodes.fragment: Was exiled for procedures too cruel to forgive, and still measures her worth by whether her exilers will admit they were wrong.

nodes.label: Bell Eater
nodes.fragment: Wakes up enraged whenever the kingdom breaks, and swallows the very bells that used to call for help.

nodes.label: Broodmother
nodes.fragment: Passes an old, forgotten guilt down through every child, and calls the inheritance a kind of penance.

nodes.label: Clover Dancers
nodes.fragment: Dances now only inside a memory, with a partner who traded away his body to save a kingdom that fell regardless.

nodes.label: Cogwork Dancers
nodes.fragment: Guard a door with a soul that was split in two just to build them, and neither half quite remembers whole.

nodes.label: Crawfather
nodes.fragment: Sits in judgment of a stranger he's already decided is to blame, in a court built entirely around his own verdict.

nodes.label: Crust King Khann
nodes.fragment: Ruled by the belief that the weak should crumble, and held out against a god longer than anyone else even tried to.

nodes.label: Disgraced Chef Lugoli
nodes.fragment: Was exiled for what went into the dishes, and kept cooking anyway, alone, in the caves that took him back.

nodes.label: Father of the Flame
nodes.fragment: Was built by worshippers into a god, with someone's actual heart still burning quietly at the center of the idea.

nodes.label: First Sinner
nodes.fragment: Knew the truth behind the lie her whole tribe was built on, and was condemned for saying so rather than believed.

nodes.label: Forebrothers Signis & Gron
nodes.fragment: Keep commanding an excavation that stopped needing commanding once the haunting took the workers instead.

nodes.label: Fourth Chorus
nodes.fragment: Was left for dead under rubble by the one warrior it failed to kill, and got back up anyway once someone new arrived.

nodes.label: Grand Mother Silk
nodes.fragment: Told her children they were divine, and believed it long enough that none of them dared wake her to ask.

nodes.label: Great Conchflies
nodes.fragment: Mated so closely that losing one is the only thing that's ever made the other run.

nodes.label: Groal the Great
nodes.fragment: Was offered an alliance once, and answered with a killing blow instead, then kept the offered friend's strength for their own.

nodes.label: Gurr the Outcast
nodes.fragment: Collects the bodies of everything he's ever hunted, and built one more stand, patiently, for something paler than the rest.

nodes.label: Last Judge
nodes.fragment: Has decided who counts as sinless for longer than anyone can remember, and never once had to explain the standard.

nodes.label: Lost Garmond
nodes.fragment: Turns black-threaded and roars at the one thing he came here to protect, and thanks her for it with his last words anyway.

nodes.label: Lost Lace
nodes.fragment: Wails up out of the Void wearing a daughter's shape, purified only once someone's willing to fight through the wailing.

nodes.label: Moorwing
nodes.fragment: Was bred to catch anyone who tried to run, and never stopped hunting once its handlers were the ones who died.

nodes.label: Moss Mother
nodes.fragment: Defends a nest far past any reasonable limit, because motherhood here doesn't come with an off switch.

nodes.label: Nyleth
nodes.fragment: Struck a deal so old it outlived her, and still gets guarded by someone who's forgotten most of the reason why.

nodes.label: Palestag
nodes.fragment: Was hunted to prove someone else's greatness, and the proof mattered more than whether the myth was ever true.

nodes.label: Phantom
nodes.fragment: Was spun and then set aside, and now plays a mournful song through a mask too broken to stay on by itself.

nodes.label: Pinstress
nodes.fragment: Held onto a warrior's code after the ones who taught it were wiped out for following it too well.

nodes.label: Plasmified Zango
nodes.fragment: Died carrying out someone else's experiment, and got brought back only to serve as more evidence of it.

nodes.label: Raging Conchfly
nodes.fragment: Fled once, watched its mate die, and has been furious about it at this doorway ever since.

nodes.label: Savage Beastfly
nodes.fragment: Spent so long charging the same locked gate that fury is now the only shape left of the attempt.

nodes.label: Second Sentinel
nodes.fragment: Was built to bring pilgrims safely inside, whether or not safety was something they actually asked for.

nodes.label: Sister Splinter
nodes.fragment: Claimed an entire forest the moment its old, quiet heart stopped watching, and has defended the theft ever since.

nodes.label: Skull Tyrant
nodes.fragment: Is the reason every pilgrim in the Marrow learns to walk quietly beneath its caves.

nodes.label: Summoned Saviour
nodes.fragment: Was stitched together out of dead pilgrims' masks by someone desperate enough not to ask what it would cost.

nodes.label: The Unravelled
nodes.fragment: Is every soul that didn't survive the operating table, still trying, together, to remember its own name.

nodes.label: Trobbio
nodes.fragment: Wants to be adored badly enough that he's willing to kill for an audience, and calls it raising the kingdom's spirits.

nodes.label: Voltvyrm
nodes.fragment: Thinks in barely more than instinct, and got studied anyway by scholars hoping to borrow its lightning.

nodes.label: Watcher at the Edge
nodes.fragment: Outlived an entire tribe just to keep guarding a border no one's left to cross, standing so still they mistake him for stone.

nodes.label: Widow
nodes.fragment: Stayed loyal long enough to be pinned into silence for it, and now drags the same silence down onto everyone else.

nodes.label: The Abyss (Silksong)
nodes.fragment: The same dark the Knight once climbed out of, waiting at the bottom of an entirely different kingdom.

nodes.label: Bellhart
nodes.fragment: Every wall rings if struck — a town that learned to sound its own alarm, and forgot why.

nodes.label: Bilewater
nodes.fragment: Chokes on its own fumes in the Citadel's shadow, and has for longer than the shadow's been falling.

nodes.label: Blasted Steps
nodes.fragment: Wind has been sanding this staircase flat since long before there was anyone left to climb it.

nodes.label: Bone Bottom
nodes.fragment: First stop on a road that only steepens from here, where pilgrims write down wishes before they know better.

nodes.label: Choral Chambers
nodes.fragment: Song still moves through these halls, though whatever used to sing here stopped being alive a long time ago.

nodes.label: The Citadel
nodes.fragment: Gold enough to blind the faithful climbing toward it, as though brightness alone could pass for mercy.

nodes.label: Cogwork Core
nodes.fragment: Ticks on exactly as designed, indifferent to the fact that what it guards has stopped deserving the effort.

nodes.label: The Cradle
nodes.fragment: Holds a sleeping god above a room full of cages built for children exactly like the one who finally woke her.

nodes.label: Deep Docks
nodes.fragment: Forges tools over a lake of fire, and calls the burns that come with the job simply part of the wage.

nodes.label: Far Fields
nodes.fragment: Warm air rises from somewhere below that would rather not be looked at too closely.

nodes.label: Grand Gate
nodes.fragment: Used to open for anyone with faith enough to climb this far, and now mostly just judges who still has any left.

nodes.label: Greymoor
nodes.fragment: Rain hasn't stopped long enough for anyone to remember dry, least of all the ones still tending the fields.

nodes.label: High Halls
nodes.fragment: Kept its water running and its halls gleaming long after the people meant to enjoy either one stopped coming.

nodes.label: Hunter's March
nodes.fragment: Every shadow here is either a red ant or a trap set by one, and the dark doesn't much care which finds you first.

nodes.label: The Marrow
nodes.fragment: Every road down here is paved in someone's bones, and none of them seem to mind the traffic.

nodes.label: Memorium
nodes.fragment: Keeps the kingdom's creatures behind glass in rooms built to lie about being their real home.

nodes.label: The Mist
nodes.fragment: Fogs over a road already littered with the last people who tried to find their way through it.

nodes.label: Moss Grotto
nodes.fragment: Stayed gentle and green while everything past its border learned to be otherwise.

nodes.label: Mosslands
nodes.fragment: Two places sharing one name and one color, as if the map itself gave up trying to tell them apart.

nodes.label: Mount Fay
nodes.fragment: Freezes anyone who lingers too long between its scattered fires, patient in the specific way only cold can be.

nodes.label: Putrified Ducts
nodes.fragment: Carries the Citadel's own filth downhill, and calls the carrying someone else's problem now.

nodes.label: Red Memory
nodes.fragment: Is a memory dressed up as a place, red-threaded and humming with a heartbeat that was never really here at all.

nodes.label: Sands of Karak
nodes.fragment: Used to have a river running through it, and kept the coral long after it forgot how to keep the water.

nodes.label: Shellwood
nodes.fragment: Green swallowed the pilgrim road so completely it forgot a road was ever meant to be walked.

nodes.label: Sinner's Road
nodes.fragment: Still breeds and butchers exactly as it always did, just with keepers too haunted now to notice they're not needed.

nodes.label: The Slab
nodes.fragment: Calls itself a place of forgiveness, though everyone actually locked inside knows better than to believe the sign.

nodes.label: Underworks
nodes.fragment: Charges its own workers to rest, in a basement built entirely to keep somebody else's lights on.

nodes.label: Verdania
nodes.fragment: Used to be lush enough to inspire a kingdom's pride, and is now mostly just a place to grieve what that pride cost.

nodes.label: Weavenest Atla
nodes.fragment: Was named for a Weaver of time, and abandoned long enough that even the name has started slipping.

nodes.label: Whispering Vaults
nodes.fragment: Held the whole Citadel's memory once, and now mostly just echoes it back to whoever still bothers to ask.

nodes.label: Whiteward
nodes.fragment: Still has the wheelchairs lined up from patients who never got wheeled back out.

nodes.label: Wisp Thicket
nodes.fragment: Stays small and dim on purpose, tucked away just far enough that its fire-worshippers go mostly unnoticed.

nodes.label: Wormways
nodes.fragment: Trembles constantly with things burrowing just beneath the floor, and no one's quite sure yet if that's dangerous or just alive.

nodes.label: The Knight
nodes.fragment: Empty inside by design, yet still descends where fuller things refuse to go.

nodes.label: Hornet (Silksong)
nodes.fragment: Slipped her captors before the cage could close, and now climbs toward a peak that does not want her.
